name: Any Human Ever - in medieval Bosnia
description: Draw a fictional life born in Bosnia from c. 600 through the Ottoman conquest of Jajce in 1527, with a selectable birth year, modern terrain map, period-varying demographic assumptions, and sourced historical context. Lifetimes may continue beyond the birth-year range.

store.tagline: One medieval Bosnian life, drawn at random.
store.description: From the Slavic settlement to the fall of the Kingdom of Bosnia. Draw a birth year, a place, a life — then read the story: who ruled, which house held the land, what wars and plagues reached it. Seeded, shareable, and grounded in real history.
